entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses a virtual filesystem with viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is designed to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It provides synthesized answers including citations and gap analysis, while supporting scoped access for multi-user teams.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper and is accessible through Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted wrapper. It provides a FastAPI server with hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection via Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like versioning. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It uses local infrastructure including Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness supports multiple providers, including Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible models. It generates filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data on a local disk. It supports MCP tools including Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw through local-first retrieval using BM25 and hybrid search stacks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, Claude Code hooks, and plugins using hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for Hermes Agent and the OpenClaw ecosystem to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching why_retrieved tags to every retrieval. It supports in-process embedded mode by default and includes features for contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets to the agent per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients using local-first SQLite-vec storage.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory and context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context. It supports stdio or SSE MCP server modes and renders context to files like.cursorrules and AGENTS.md without requiring accounts or hosted services.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores data as inspectable Markdown files to ensure memory ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex for long-term, cross-project memory.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across various chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate payments for agent operations.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides tools for knowledge search, neighbor traversal, and optional automatic tool-routing note generation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall alongside MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development for engineering tasks while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology compatible with harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 artifacts from design systems using a sandboxed iframe preview. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including specific support for Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness.

It enables Hermes Agents to handle diverse media tasks such as text de-humanization and brand-overlay creation.

entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project provides a terminal-based interface and dashboard for managing Hermes profiles, skills, and cron jobs. It includes a dedicated kanban board for tracking agentic work and task management.

entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for the self-hosted assistant. Users can manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through an integrated file browser and management suite.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process oversight by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native streaming SSE responses.
